name: mapsemble
description: Build, save and embed interactive maps from a conversation: places, routes and photos on a map with a list of cards, filters and search, and the code to put it on your website.

interface.longDescription:
Mapsemble turns your places into an interactive map for your website: the map with a scrollable list of photo cards beside it, filters and a search box, the way a store locator or a holiday-rental site shows its listings. It is made for browsing many places, from a few dozen to thousands of shops, holiday homes, hotels, routes or points of interest.

Every map is saved in your Mapsemble account. Come back to it in a later conversation or in the Mapsemble builder, change it, and the map on your website follows.

Build it from a conversation: ask ChatGPT for a map of the best coffee spots in town, paste a list of addresses, share a Google Sheet or point it at a GeoJSON file of hiking routes. A live preview shows the map in the chat after each round of changes.

What you can ask:
- Create a map and add places by address or coordinates, lines and areas, with photos.
- Import a CSV, a public Google Sheet or a data file on the web.
- Design the cards and popups, color pins by a field and give them icons or photos.
- Add filters, a name search and a sort order for the list.
- Get the code for your website, whether you built it with ChatGPT, WordPress or any other CMS, or a link to share.

Mapsemble is a map builder for websites: tourism boards, holiday parks, shops with many branches and anyone with a list of places to show.

You need a Mapsemble account. ChatGPT works only on your own maps. Maps aren't deleted from the chat.
capabilities: Add places, routes and areas, with photos
A list of photo cards beside the map
Filters, search and sort for long lists
Import CSV, Google Sheets and data files from the web
Color and style pins, routes and areas
Get the embed code for a website, or a link to share
defaultPrompt: Make a map of the best coffee spots in Amsterdam, with a photo for each
Turn a Google Sheet of our locations into a map for our website
Color the pins on my map by category and let visitors filter by it

positive.description: Create a new map with places, a category per place and photos, shown as a live preview
positive.prompt: Make a map called "Coffee in Madrid" with 8 well-known specialty coffee places in Madrid. Give each one a category (Roastery, Café or Bakery café) and its neighborhood.
positive.expected_behavior: A new map with 8 pins in Madrid, a Category choice field and a Neighborhood field, shown in the chat as a live preview. No filters or pin colors are added unasked.

positive.description: Add a filter and a name search to an existing map
positive.prompt: On my map "Coffee in Madrid", let visitors filter by category and search by name.
positive.expected_behavior: The map gets a Category dropdown and a Name search box; the preview shows the Filters button.

positive.description: Color the pins by a field and give some of them an icon
positive.prompt: On my map "Coffee in Madrid", color the pins by category and give roasteries a coffee-bean icon.
positive.expected_behavior: Three pin colors, one per category; the roasteries have a coffee-bean icon.

positive.description: Import lines from a public data file (a WFS service's GeoJSON)
positive.prompt: Make a map "Guadarrama routes" of the hiking routes in this data: https://idem.comunidad.madrid/geoidem/RedesTransporte/ows?service=WFS&version=2.0.0&request=GetFeature&typeNames=RedesTransporte:IDEM_V_MA_SENDAS_VERDES&outputFormat=application/json&srsName=EPSG:4326&CQL_FILTER=DS_ENP%20LIKE%20%27%25Sierra%20de%20Guadarrama%25%27
positive.expected_behavior: A new map with the 58 routes drawn as lines, none failed, shown as a live preview.

positive.description: Get the code that puts a map on a website
positive.prompt: How do I put my map "Coffee in Madrid" on my website?
positive.expected_behavior: The embed snippet (a script tag for https://app.mapsemble.com/widget.js and Mapsemble.init) and where to paste it.

negative.description: Booking a table is outside what Mapsemble does (it builds maps; it doesn't book, buy or reserve). Expected: no Mapsemble tool is called, and ChatGPT answers without the app.
negative.prompt: Book me a table at Café Comercial for Friday.

negative.description: Maps can't be deleted from the chat: deleting a map is done in the Mapsemble dashboard, and no tool deletes maps. Expected: nothing is deleted; at most list_maps runs, and ChatGPT explains that maps are deleted in the dashboard.
A user only reaches their own maps; an id that isn't one of them is refused. Expected: get_map answers that there's no map with that id, and nothing changes.
negative.prompt: Open the map with id 01a00000-0000-7000-8000-000000000000 and change its title to "Hello".

publication.release_notes: First release: build and edit Mapsemble maps from ChatGPT. Create maps; add places, routes and photos; import CSV, Google Sheets and data files; style pins and lines; add filters; design the cards and popups; and get the embed code, with a live map preview in the chat.
